messages:
Maya P: Quick async check — Q2 OKR milestone for cross-pillar shiplane. Please drop a 1-line update: shipped / slipped / next step / owner. Target: wrap by EOD Fri. Thx!

Ben: Shipped: runtime v2 autoscale (canary->100%) — PR: https://github.com/redwood/re/runtime/pull/1234 :shipit:
Slipped: int8 quant test suite — perf regression on long sequences (KV cache perf), root cause suspected NVRT kernel mismatch.
Next: roll revert + perf patch, re-run benchmarks.
Owner: Ben
ETA: Wed 2026-03-18

Olivia: Shipped: Console per-route latency dashboard + tracing hooks (deployed to staging).
Slipped: rollout automation for Dedicated policy templates (edge case with config merge).
Next: pair with eng-infra for merge strategy.
Owner: Olivia
ETA: Fri 2026-03-20

Chen: Blocked: Dedicated capacity tests failing in us-west-2 due to instance quota shortage; cloud ticket open.
Owner: Chen
Ask: Need quota bump from cloud ops (@Reshma)

Reshma: Pinging infra cloud ops now (INC-4578). Cloud acknowledged, quota bump estimated within 24h. Added temporary spot fallback to unblock smoke tests.

Ben: Failing test excerpt:
```
AssertionError: kv_cache_miss >= 0
  File "tests/quant_perf.py", line 87, in test_long_seq_performance
    assert avg_latency < 200
```

Maya P: Thanks — can we flag any outstanding code reviews blocking releases?

Olivia: CRs: platform#345 needs a second review + labeling. Ben, can you take a look by EOD?

Ben: On it, will submit review comments by 17:00 PT.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy of runtime v2 autoscale completed at 2026-03-17T14:05Z :white_check_mark:

Chen: After quota bump I'll run full e2e smoke and upload logs to /shared/q2/shiplane-logs.

Maya P: Summary for the Q2 update:
- Shipped: runtime autoscale (canary->prod), console latency dashboard
- Slipped: int8 quant tests, dedicated rollout automation
- Blockers: cloud quota (in flight)
- Next steps / owners: Ben (perf patch), Olivia (infra pairing), Chen (post-quota smoke)
Thanks all :tada:
